**THE POSITION**
Saildrone is applying modern machine learning and computer vision to autonomous vehicles operating in challenging, poorly observed environments. As a Perception Machine Learning Engineer, you will develop and deploy ML-based perception capabilities using real-world vehicle data.
  
  
You will work across model development, data, evaluation, and production deployment.
  
  
**The Responsibilities**

* Develop machine-learning-based perception systems for autonomous vehicles.
* Train, evaluate, and improve computer vision models using real-world sensor data.
* Develop data and experimentation workflows to identify failure modes and improve model performance.
* Build perception capabilities for detection, classification, segmentation, depth estimation, or scene understanding.
* Analyze vehicle data and model failures to identify weaknesses and drive improvements.
* Integrate models into production perception systems.
* Bring new machine learning techniques from experimentation into deployed systems.

**The Qualifications**

* Strong Python programming skills.
* Hands-on experience developing computer vision or machine learning systems.
* Strong experience with PyTorch or a comparable ML framework.
* Strong understanding of computer vision fundamentals and real-world visual data.
* Experience evaluating models using quantitative metrics and experimental analysis.
* Experience taking ML or computer vision systems into production.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* C++ experience for production perception systems.
* Robotics, autonomous vehicle, aerospace, or defense experience.
* Edge or embedded ML deployment.
* Sensor fusion, 3D perception, or multimodal perception.
* ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA, or other inference optimization experience.
